empty.title: Add your first feed
empty.body: Paste the address of a website or a feed above, or import an OPML file below.

add.title: Add a feed
add.label: Website or feed address
add.hint: Paste a website or a feed link. If the website offers several feeds, you can choose one.

chooser.title: Choose a feed
chooser.lead: This website offers several feeds. Which one do you want to add?

rename.title: Rename folder
rename.label: Folder name
rename.merge: A folder with this name already exists. Its feeds will be merged with this one.

settings.title: Feed settings
settings.titleHint: Leave empty to use the feed's own title, “{{title}}”.
settings.allowDuplicatesHint: Off: a story that several of your feeds carry is shown only once.
settings.hiddenHint: Leaves this feed out of the sidebar and the combined lists, such as For you. It keeps updating.
settings.imagesHintOn: Your global setting loads images from all feeds. “Always block” overrides it for this feed.
settings.imagesHintOff: Your global setting blocks images from all feeds. “Always allow” still works for this feed.

classification.title: Classification

help.off: Off and Training are selection only: nothing is analysed unless you select it. Switch to training to choose articles to analyse.
help.training: Training is selection only: nothing is analysed unless you select it. Choose articles in this feed to teach Bantoozi what you like.
help.active: New articles from this feed are classified automatically. Older articles stay as they are unless you select them.

classification.since: Automatic classification has been on since {{date}}.
classification.switchBack: Switching back or turning classification off stops new analysis for this feed. Work that is already running can still finish, because other subscribers of this feed may share it.
classification.stale: This setting was changed from another device. We've reloaded it. Check the current setting and try again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from “{{title}}”?
unsubscribe.body: You'll stop receiving its articles. Bookmarks you saved from it and your image setting for it are kept.

opml.title: Import and export
opml.fileHint: An .opml or .xml file exported from another feed reader.

report.title: Import finished
report.existing_one: {{count}} feed was already in your list.
report.existing_other: {{count}} feeds were already in your list.

reasons.invalid_url: This isn't a valid web address.
reasons.unsupported_scheme: Only http and https addresses are supported.
reasons.credentials: The address contains a username or password, which isn't allowed.
reasons.credential_param: The address contains a secret key or token, which isn't allowed.
reasons.blocked_address: The address points to a network that can't be used for feeds.
reasons.missing_url: The entry has no feed address.
reasons.quota_exceeded: Your plan's feed limit was reached before this entry.

errors.invalid: That file isn't a valid OPML file. Export it again from your other reader and try once more.
errors.tooLarge: That OPML file is too large. Split it into smaller files and import them one at a time.
errors.tooManyFeeds: This file lists {{used}} feeds, but your plan allows importing {{max}} at a time. Split the file and import it in parts.
